title: A flaw was found in GIMP. Importing a crafted SBZ palette without a color-model attribute can cause a NULL pointer dereference during string… (CVE-2026-112259)
description: A vulnerability in GIMP allows denial of service when importing a crafted SBZ palette file lacking a color-model attribute. This causes a NULL pointer dereference during string comparison, crashing the application.
aiSummary: The vulnerability in GIMP arises from improper handling of SBZ palette files that do not include a color-model attribute. When such a crafted file is imported, the application attempts a string comparison on a NULL pointer, leading to a NULL pointer dereference and resulting in a denial of service condition by crashing the GIMP application.
aiImpact: Successful exploitation causes denial of service by crashing the GIMP application. There is no impact on confidentiality or integrity, only availability is affected.
